Initial release of smyx-fish-surface-symptom-detection-analysis.

- Detects three common ornamental fish surface symptoms from high-resolution images: white-spot disease, hyperemia, and fin-rot.
- Outputs detected symptom types, confidence scores, affected locations, and severity levels for each fish.
- Provides structured health reports per tank, including a 4-level alert system with recommended actions (excluding medication specifics).
- Supports periodic snapshots or real-time monitoring for home aquariums, public aquariums, and fish farms.
- Includes open-id/user validation and strict privacy/accuracy controls for result handling and report history queries.
- Warns against misuse of AI outputs for diagnosis or unapproved interventions; medication advice requires a veterinarian.
